Config load failed before any test file was collected.
Therefore ZERO test files were collected and ZERO tests ran; the required 258 files / 7 authorized skips / 0 failed could not be observed.

Per STOP CONDITIONS: runtime mismatch -> accepted=false, enumerated, no retry, no repair, stop for independent review. The RO-node_modules immutability design is incompatible with vitest 3.2.4/vite 7 config bundling, which requires a writable node_modules/.vite-temp.
